canonical_claim: George de Mestral developed the idea for Velcro after examining burrs that clung to his clothing and his dog's fur.
subject: Velcro fastener
object_or_result: burr hooks clinging to clothing and dog fur
surface_text: Velcro began after George de Mestral studied burrs clinging to clothes and dog fur

sources.title: George De Mestral
sources.supports: Describes de Mestral examining burrs from his trousers and dog fur, then developing a hook-and-loop fastening system.
